## Description
Please clearly describe the issue you're having to the best of your ability.

### Environment
**Mod Version:** 
**Mod Loader/Minecraft Version:** 
**Dedicated Server:** 

### Upload log
Please use [**mclo.gs**](https://mclo.gs) to upload your `latest.log` file and/or crash report.

### Needed to reproduce (if applicable)
Please describe any specific information that might be required to replicate the problem. This may include specific steps you took to arrive at the issue, mods you have installed, etc.

### Expected behavior (if applicable)
A brief description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots (if applicable)
Attach screenshots if needed to illustrate your point, especially if it's a visual issue.
